exposure: CRH concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
Progesterone concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
Estradiol concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
Total triiodothyronine (T3) concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
Free thyroxine (fT4) concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
Testosterone concentrations at 18 and 26 weeks gestation
cohort: 976 women in the PROTECT study, a longitudinal birth cohort in Puerto Rico
finding: Higher circulating CRH, progesterone, and fT4 concentrations at 18 weeks gestation were associated with reduced gestational age at birth specifically among male fetuses.
